items.headline: Live highlights and top CFP analysis from Week 10's big games
items.description: We're tracking the games of the season's biggest week and how they'll affect the next playoff rankings.

items.headline: Devon Dampier puts Utes 'on his back' for blockbuster win over BYU
items.description: In what was the first-ever Holy War matchup between BYU and Utah as top-10 teams, the game delivered a blockbuster that featured several big momentum swings and a QB in Devon Dampier at the center of it all who propelled the Utes to a 28-20 win.

items.headline: No. 3 Utah snaps three-game losing streak to No. 7 BYU with 28-20 win over Cougars
items.description: — Devon Dampier accounted for four touchdowns, Utah intercepted four Bear Bachmeier passes and the third-ranked Utes remained undefeated with a 28-20 victory over No. 7 BYU on Saturday.

items.headline: BYU star RB LJ Martin returns, plays vs. No. 3 Utah
items.description: BYU star RB LJ Martin, who hasn't played since Oct. 3 due to an ankle injury, will return for the Cougars' showdown vs. No. 3 Utah, coach Kalani Sitake told ESPN.
